categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: real estate business involving land development, office buildings, industrial and logistics property management and leasing; textile business focusing on fabric and related products including wool blankets, underwear, garments, and military uniform supply projects; and general investment activities. The real estate segment accounts for the majority of revenue, followed by textiles and investment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The real estate segment focuses on land planning, development, and property management without manufacturing processes. The textile segment utilizes advanced wool textile technology and functional fabric development such as elastic, moisture-wicking, wrinkle-resistant, and lightweight thermal fabrics. The company also invests in renewable energy, including rooftop solar power installations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include commercial tenants for real estate properties primarily in Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan, and military uniform contractors and general consumers for textile products. The textile business serves mainly domestic markets with a significant portion dedicated to military uniform supply projects. Investment activities target various industries through subsidiaries and equity investments.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in Taiwan, with real estate properties located in Taipei City, New Taipei City (Xinzhuang District), and Taoyuan City (Dayuan District). Overseas investments are made through private equity funds in developed countries, focusing on income-generating or leasable properties. Textile sales are primarily domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the supply chain: in real estate through property development and leasing; in textiles through fabric production and product sales; and in investments through holding and managing subsidiaries. It does not engage in upstream raw material production but sources textile raw materials mostly from international suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing profitability and asset utilization in real estate through development and refurbishment, expanding renewable energy projects such as solar power installations on owned properties, and developing functional textile products to meet market demands. The company emphasizes ESG and sustainability integration in real estate development and operations, aligning with climate change and net-zero carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily from rental income and property management fees in the real estate segment, product sales in the textile segment (including military uniform supply contracts), and investment income from subsidiaries and equity-method associates. The company also gains from financial asset valuation and foreign exchange gains.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the textile sector, the company is one of the few professional wool textile suppliers in Taiwan and a major supplier for military uniform projects, competing on product quality and service reliability. In real estate, it competes in the commercial and industrial property markets in northern Taiwan, focusing on prime locations with strong infrastructure. The company positions itself as a diversified holding with stable income sources and growth potential in green energy.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$846 million in 2024, with real estate contributing 67%, textiles 22%, and investments 11%. Net profit increased by 15% year-over-year to about NT$661 million. Total assets grew 7% to NT$13.7 billion, with equity attributable to owners at NT$8.3 billion, reflecting steady growth and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes stable and diversified income streams through its integrated real estate, textile, and investment businesses. It differentiates by leveraging prime real estate locations with high occupancy rates, specialized wool textile expertise with functional product development, and commitment to sustainability and ESG principles. Its long-standing brand reputation and strong governance further enhance stakeholder confidence.
